title: Clean up TermAl's ended delegation worktrees and orphaned test worktrees under ~/.termal/delegations (Codex executor only)
outcome: TermAl's ended delegation worktrees and the orphaned test worktrees under C:/Users/grzeg/.termal/delegations are removed after their work is preserved, by a Codex session only. Anything that cannot be fully preserved stays and is reported. The report says what was removed, how much space was reclaimed, and what remains and why.
acceptance: Executor is a Codex session (agent Codex, model recorded); no Opus/Claude session deletes anything. Only direct children C:/Users/grzeg/.termal/delegations/delegation-<uuid> are touched, each resolved to an absolute path and checked to lie in exactly that directory before any removal; the mcp/ subdirectory, Engram's ten delegation folders and the system TEMP are not touched.

For each of TermAl's eight real-repo worktrees (298c66b8, fafc4989, 8ab3ecaa, 386f6be6, 5c4aa0d9, 7b1578a1, a0e354f1, bc926923): the delegation is shown terminal and its child session not active from TermAl's API; every unique commit is reachable from a ref, or preserved as a local branch preserve/delegation-<id8>; uncommitted and untracked files are saved under the TermAl repo's .evidence/delegation-cleanup-2026-11-16/<id8>/ and verified readable. Then it is removed with git worktree remove from C:/github/Personal/TermAl (with --force only after that preservation is verified), without a global prune. A worktree that cannot be fully preserved is left and reported.

For each orphaned test worktree: its worktree/.git file's gitdir and the repository it names do not exist, and it is not registered in any existing repository. Only then is that delegation-<uuid> folder removed. Anything else is left and reported.
A report note lists counts removed, bytes reclaimed (measured before and after), and every folder left with its reason; the evidence folder is listed for retention until this item closes.
